title: Forgotten password: reset and sign in
summary: Request a reset link, verify your identity, choose a new password, and sign in again.

steps.say: Choose Forgot your password? on the sign-in page. A reset needs access to your account email and your authenticator or an unused recovery code.
Enter your MERIT user name and choose Email me a reset link. Use your user name rather than guessing an email address.
The same Check your email message appears whether an account exists or not. Check junk or spam. No email? Check your user name and contact your administrator.
onScreen: Check your email · If MERIT has an account with that user name and an email address, we've sent it a link to reset the password. The link works once, for 20 minutes. · Email can take a minute or two to arrive. Check your junk or spam folder too. Only the newest link works. · No email? You may have mistyped the user name, or the account may have no email address. Contact your MERIT administrator. ·

steps.say: Open the link from the newest email. It works once and for the time shown. The email itself is kept off camera because the link is private.
The link alone is not enough. Enter an authenticator code, or an unused recovery code. A recovery code is used up when the reset succeeds.
onScreen: Six digits from the app, or a ten-character recovery code (a recovery code is then used up).

steps.say: A wrong verification code leaves the password unchanged and uses an attempt on this link. Read the error before retrying.
actions: Types into Code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code (hidden)

steps.say: Choose a long passphrase that meets the minimum shown. Enter the same new password twice. MERIT also rejects known breached passwords.
actions: Types into Code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code (hidden)

steps.say: Correct the fields, enter a current code, and choose Reset password. MERIT confirms the reset and signs out other sessions on this account.
actions: Types into Code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code (hidden)

steps.say: A reset link cannot be used again. If you did not make the reset, contact your MERIT administrator.
onScreen: This link was already used. If you didn't reset your password, contact your MERIT administrator.

steps.say: Go back to sign in. Use your new password, then the normal authenticator step. Resetting a password does not remove MFA.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)
